content: अभिभाष् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (<ab>P.</ab> in epic poetry) .²1 To speak to, address; talk or converse with (with <ab>acc.</ab>); भोभवत्पूर्वकं त्वेनमभिभाषेत धर्मवित् <ls>Ms. 2. 128</ls>; नोदक्यामभिभाषेत <ls>Ms. 4. 57</ls> sometimes with <ab>instr.</ab> also; .²2 To speak, say (as वाणीम्, वचः <ab>&c.</ab>); इति अभिभाषन्ते so they say. .²3 To relate, narrate, speak of. .²4 To proclaim, announce, confess; गुरुतल्प्यभिभाष्यैनस्तप्ते स्वप्यादयोमये <ls>Ms. 11. 103</ls>.
